movers24h.vulnerabilityName: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Gitea Code Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Gitea contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an attacker with repository write access to send a malicious patch to the diffpatch API endpoint to plant an executable Git hook and run shell commands as the Gitea service account.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Marimo Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Marimo contains an pre-authorization remote code execution vulnerability, allowing an unauthenticated attacked to shell access and execute arbitrary system commands.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Remote Code Execution
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Office Excel contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to take complete control of an affected system if a user opens a specially crafted Excel file that includes a malformed object.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Link Following Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows contains a link following vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Samsung Mobile Devices Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Samsung mobile devices contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in libimagecodec.quram.so. This vulnerability could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L devices contains a command injection vulnerability in the cgi-bin/ddns_enc.cgi. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA100 Appliances OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA100 appliances contain an OS command injection vulnerability in the SSL-VPN management interface that allows a remote, authenticated attacker with administrative privilege to inject arbitrary commands as a 'nobody' user.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: JQuery Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: JQuery contains a persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. When passing maliciously formed, untrusted input enclosed in HTML tags, JQuery's DOM manipulators can execute untrusted code in the context of the user's browser.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Management Console Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Management Console contains unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform Spoofing Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform contains a user interface (UI) misrepresentation of critical information vulnerability that allows an attacker to spoof a web page. This vulnerability was exploited in conjunction with CVE-2024-38112.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: VMware ESXi Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: VMware ESXi contains an authentication bypass vulnerability. A malicious actor with sufficient Active Directory (AD) permissions can gain full access to an ESXi host that was previously configured to use AD for user management by re-creating the configured AD group ('ESXi Admins' by default) after it was deleted from AD.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: GNU C Library Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: GNU C Library's dynamic loader ld.so contains a buffer overflow vulnerability when processing the GLIBC_TUNABLES environment variable, allowing a local attacker to execute code with elevated privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Juniper Junos OS EX Series PHP External Variable Modification Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Juniper Junos OS on EX Series contains a PHP external variable modification vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to control certain, important environment variables. Using a crafted request an attacker is able to modify certain PHP environment variables, leading to partial loss of integrity, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Skype for Business Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Skype for Business contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Veritas Backup Exec Agent File Access Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Veritas Backup Exec (BE) Agent contains a file access vulnerability that could allow an attacker to specially craft input parameters on a data management protocol command to access files on the BE Agent machine.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows an attacker with access to the server administrator's Plex account to upload a malicious file via the Camera Upload feature and have the media server execute it.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: TIBCO JasperReports Library Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: TIBCO JasperReports Library contains a directory-traversal vulnerability that may allow web server users to access contents of the host system.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Veeam Backup & Replication Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The Veeam Distribution Service in the Backup & Replication application allows unauthenticated users to access internal API functions. A remote attacker can send input to the internal API which may lead to uploading and executing of malicious code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows Uncontrolled Search Path Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows allows for incorrect handling of directory paths. An attacker with valid credentials on Windows would be able to copy malicious files to arbitrary locations with system level privileges. This could include DLL pre-loading, DLL hijacking, and other related attacks.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: PEAR Archive_Tar Improper Link Resolution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: PEAR Archive_Tar Tar.php allows write operations with directory traversal due to inadequate checking of symbolic links. PEAR stands for PHP Extension and Application Repository and it is an open-source framework and distribution system for reusable PHP components with known usage in third-party products such as Drupal Core and Red Hat Linux.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR Multiple Devices Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Multiple NETGEAR devices contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for authentication bypass and remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player Unspecified Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe Flash Player contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player and AIR Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Use-after-free vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player and Adobe AIR allows attackers to execute code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: JScript in Microsoft Internet Explorer allows remote attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: VMware vCenter Server and Cloud Foundation Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: VMware vCenter Server and Cloud Foundation Server contain a SSRF vulnerability due to improper validation of URLs in a vCenter Server plugin. This allows for information disclosure.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows SAM Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: If a Volume Shadow Copy (VSS) shadow copy of the system drive is available, users can read the SAM file which would allow any user to escalate privileges to SYSTEM level.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Nagios XI OS Command Injection
movers24h.shortDescription: Nagios XI contains a vulnerability which can lead to OS command injection on the Nagios XI server.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apache HTTP Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apache HTTP Server, with MPM event, worker or prefork, code executing in less-privileged child processes or threads (including scripts executed by an in-process scripting interpreter) could execute code with the privileges of the parent process (usually root) by manipulating the scoreboard.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft MSHTML Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft MSHTML engine contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for remote code execution vulnerability.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to exploit insufficient validation of path information provided by users.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Code Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a code injection vulnerability which in specific conditions could potentially enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Joomlack Page Builder Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Joomlack Page Builder contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via unauthenticated arbitrary file upload.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Defender Insufficient Granularity of Access Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Defender contains an insufficient granularity of access control vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to escalate privileges locally.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Multiple Products Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Email Gateway, Secure Email, AsyncOS Software, and Web Manager appliances contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows threat actors to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system of an affected appliance.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: OpenPLC ScadaBR Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: OpenPLC ScadaBR contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows remote authenticated users to upload and execute arbitrary JSP files via view_edit.shtm.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel PIE Stack Buffer Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Linux kernel contains a position-independent executable (PIE) stack buffer corruption vulnerability in load_elf_ binary() that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: FXC AE1021, AE1021PE OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: FXC AE1021 and AE1021PE contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute commands via a network.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Juniper Junos OS EX Series Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Juniper Junos OS on EX Series contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to cause limited impact to the file system integrity. With a specific request to installAppPackage.php that doesn't require authentication, an attacker is able to upload arbitrary files via J-Web, leading to a loss of integrity for a certain part of the file system, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Service Location Protocol (SLP) Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The Service Location Protocol (SLP) contains a denial-of-service (DoS) vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to register services and use spoofed UDP traffic to conduct a denial-of-service (DoS) attack with a significant amplification factor.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows for code execution in the context of the current user.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium libvpx Heap Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chromium libvpx contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in vp8 encoding that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could impact web browsers using libvpx, including but not limited to Google Chrome.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiClient EMS Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiClient EMS contains an improper access control vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted requests.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SolarWinds Serv-U Uncontrolled Resource Consumption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SolarWinds Serv-U contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows specially crafted POST requests using the Content-Encoding: deflate header to crash the Serv-U service without authentication.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Sangoma FreePBX Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Sangoma FreePBX contains an authentication bypass vulnerability due to insufficiently sanitized user-supplied data allows unauthenticated access to FreePBX Administrator leading to arbitrary database manipulation and remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Identity Services Engine Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco Identity Services Engine contains an injection vulnerability in a specific API of Cisco ISE and Cisco ISE-PIC due to insufficient validation of user-supplied input allowing an attacker to exploit this vulnerability by submitting a crafted API request. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to perform remote code execution and obtaining root privileges on an affected device.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: QNAP NAS File Station Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A cross-site scripting vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to inject malicious code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel DSL CPE OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Multiple Zyxel DSL CPE devices contain a post-authentication command injection vulnerability in the management commands that could allow an authenticated attacker to execute OS commands via Telnet.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver contains a use-after-free vulnerability that may allow a non-privileged user to gain root privilege and/or disclose information.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) Code Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability in the API component that allows an authenticated attacker to remotely execute arbitrary code via crafted API requests. This vulnerability results from an insecure implementation of the Hibernate Validator open-source library, as represented by CVE-2025-35036.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS XE Web UI Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco IOS XE contains a command injection vulnerability in the web user interface. When chained with CVE-2023-20198, the attacker can leverage the new local user to elevate privilege to root and write the implant to the file system. Cisco identified CVE-2023-20273 as the vulnerability exploited to deploy the implant. CVE-2021-1435, previously associated with the exploitation events, is no longer believed to be related to this activity.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: VMware ESXi and Horizon DaaS OpenSLP Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: VMware ESXi and Horizon Desktop as a Service (DaaS) OpenSLP contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to port 427 to overwrite the heap of the OpenSLP service to perform remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Unspecified vulnerability allows for an authenticated user to escalate privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Roundcube Webmail Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Roundcube Webmail contains an remote code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code via shell metacharacters in a configuration setting for im_convert_path or im_identify_path.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-859 Router Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-859 routers contain a path traversal vulnerability in the file /hedwig.cgi of the component HTTP POST Request Handler. Manipulation of the argument service with the input ../../../../htdocs/webinc/getcfg/DHCPS6.BRIDGE-1.xml allows for the leakage of session data potentially enabling privilege escalation and unauthorized control of the device. This vulnerability affects legacy D-Link products. All associated hardware revisions have reached their end-of-life (EOL) or end-of-service (EOS) life cycle and should be retired and replaced per vendor instructions.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Sitecore CMS and Experience Platform (XP) Deserialization Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Sitecore CMS and Experience Platform (XP) contain a deserialization vulnerability in the Sitecore.Security.AntiCSRF module that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code by sending a serialized .NET object in the HTTP POST parameter __CSRFTOKEN.

movers7d.product: Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS)
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) contain a command injection vulnerability, which can allow an unauthenticated attacker to inject commands that are run as a site user.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks Expedition Missing Authentication Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks Expedition contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to takeover an Expedition admin account and potentially access configuration secrets, credentials, and other data.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Hardcoded Credential Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a hardcoded credential vulnerability that could allow a remote, unauthenticated user to access internal functionality and modify data.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: DrayTek Multiple Vigor Routers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: DrayTek Vigor3900, Vigor2960, and Vigor300B devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability in cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi/cvmcfgupload that allows for remote code execution via shell metacharacters in a filename when the text/x-python-script content type is used.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Netwrix Auditor Insecure Object Deserialization Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Netwrix Auditor User Activity Video Recording component contains an insecure objection deserialization vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute code as the NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM user. Successful exploitation requires that the attacker is able to reach port 9004/TCP, which is commonly blocked by standard enterprise firewalling.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: XStream Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: XStream contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate the processed input stream and replace or inject objects that result in the execution of a local command on the server. This vulnerability can affect multiple products, including but not limited to VMware Cloud Foundation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apache Spark Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apache Spark contains a command injection vulnerability via Spark User Interface (UI) when Access Control Lists (ACLs) are enabled.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat JBoss Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Unauthenticated access to the JBoss Application Server Web Console (/web-console) is blocked by default. However, it was found that this block was incomplete, and only blocked GET and POST HTTP verbs. A remote attacker could use this flaw to gain access to sensitive information.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Unspecified vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to execute code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX Unrestricted File Upload Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Telerik.Web.UI in Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX allows remote attackers to perform arbitrary file uploads or execute arbitrary code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: MiCollab, MiVoice Business Express Access Control Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A vulnerability has been identified in MiCollab and MiVoice Business Express that may allow a malicious actor to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information and services, cause performance degradations or a denial of service condition on the affected system.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apache Kylin OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apache Kylin contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could permit an attacker to perform remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR WNR2000v5 Router Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The NETGEAR WNR2000v5 router contains a buffer overflow which can be exploited to achieve remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: D-Link and TRENDnet Multiple Devices Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The ping tool in multiple D-Link and TRENDnet devices allow remote attackers to perform remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Object Linking & Embedding (OLE) Automation Array Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: OleAut32.dll in OLE in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to remotely execute code via a crafted web site.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Reader and Adobe Acrobat Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Stack-based buffer overflow in Adobe Reader and Adobe Acrobat allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Transaction Manager Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when the Windows Transaction Manager improperly handles objects in memory.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center Server-Side Template Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center contain a server-side template injection vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: An unspecified vulnerability exists in the Win32k.sys kernel-mode driver in Microsoft Windows Server that allows a local attacker to execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-645 Router Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-645 Wired/Wireless Router allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via a GetDeviceSettings action to the HNAP interface.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Grandstream Networks UCM6200 Series SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Grandstream UCM6200 series is vulnerable to an unauthenticated remote SQL injection via crafted HTTP request. Exploitation can allow for code execution as root.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code in the context of the current user.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: MongoDB mongo-express Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: mongo-express before 0.54.0 is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution via endpoints that uses the `toBSON` method.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik Router OS Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS through 6.42 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read arbitrary files and remote authenticated attackers to write arbitrary files due to a directory traversal vulnerability in the WinBox interface.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center contain a path traversal vulnerability in the downloadallattachments resource that may allow a privileged, remote attacker to write files. Exploitation can lead to remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IP Phones Web Server Remote Code Execution and Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco IP Phones contain an improper input validation vulnerability for HTTP requests. Exploitation could allow an attacker to execute code remotely with root privileges or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) condition.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: IBM Planning Analytics Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: IBM Planning Analytics is vulnerable to a configuration overwrite that allows an unauthenticated user to login as "admin", and then execute code as root or SYSTEM via TM1 scripting.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Office contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to the way objects are handled in memory. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution in the context of the current user. This vulnerability is known to be chained with CVE-2018-0802.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: PlaySMS Server-Side Template Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: PlaySMS contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Tenda AC11 Router Stack Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Tenda AC11 devices contain a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in /goform/setmac which allows attackers to execute code via a crafted post request.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: ThinkPHP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: ThinkPHP contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via public//?s=index/\think\app/invokefunction&function=call_user_func_array&vars[0]=system&vars[1][]= followed by the command.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

newest.vulnerabilityName: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

newest.vulnerabilityName: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

newest.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Pixel Improper Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Improper Privilege Management and Missing Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to transfer and execute files through an active remote session without authorization or host confirmation.

newest.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that leads to a privilege escalation attack due to a validation check of the token signature/issuer and not the token’s scope.
